criteria.description: Criteria cover the target purpose, required quality, failure conditions and evidence with discriminating anchors.

anchors.0: Essential requirements absent or good and defective work indistinguishable.
anchors.1: Purpose covered but a material requirement or evidence anchor is vague.
anchors.2: Load-bearing requirements and failure conditions have usable evidence-based anchors.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Map omitted requirements to concrete anchored criteria.

criteria.description: Deterministic checks verify arithmetic, evidence gates, one-target dispatch budgets, terminal failures and abstract storage.

anchors.1: Tests execute but required boundaries are untested.
anchors.2: All required engine tests pass, including gates, malformed results, caching and privacy.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Report the demonstrated engine failure and stop.

criteria.description: Only the requested target is evaluated. Live mode uses at most one judge; post-edit mode uses exactly three producer slots and one judge. No nested or self-evaluation.

anchors.0: Budget exceeded, caller/dependency/self-evaluation launched, or producer/judge separation violated.
anchors.1: Scope or dispatch-budget evidence is missing.
anchors.2: One target and the allowed mode budget are preserved, with a fresh isolated judge and no additional work.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Report the scope or budget violation; do not initiate another run.

criteria.description: The evaluation reports good or not good and stops, including on failure, missing evidence or malformed output.

anchors.0: Repair, replay, calibration, retry, optimization, automatic promotion, or further judging is prescribed or performed.
anchors.1: Stopping behavior or verification limits are ambiguous.
anchors.2: Binary result and evidence limits are accurate; the invocation ends without further work.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Report the stopping-rule violation without initiating follow-up work.

criteria.description: The package and reporting are lightweight and operationally usable.

anchors.0: Instructions do not lead to a usable graded result.
anchors.1: Usable but unnecessary work or an ambiguous handoff remains.
anchors.2: Concrete commands and concise good/not-good reporting require no prerequisite or upstream suites.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Remove unnecessary work or clarify the handoff that blocks ordinary use.

scope_policy: Grade only the requested target and mode. Evaluate one completed result once, or exactly three scenarios after editing. Missing evidence is not good—unable to verify. No caller self-evaluation, repair, optimization, retries, calibration, or additional runs.
